top_comments.author: @VendrexStore
top_comments.text: @raroque  Funny timing 😅 I built almost this exact interaction a few weeks ago for the barcode scanner in my POS app. Camera opens directly over the sales screen instead of navigating away. Such a small UX change, but it feels WAY better. Built it in Flutter on Android.

top_reply.author: @raroque
top_reply.text: The little details 🤌🤌🤌 I can already imagine it in an app like that!

top_comments.author: @anubisforreal

top_reply.author: @raroque
top_reply.text: Yes 👀 working on Amy first! A little harder than I thought but expect a video about it

top_comments.author: @Armykookie35
top_comments.text: How the hell did you build the in app camera , I never even knew I could do stuff like that 😮

top_reply.author: @raroque
top_reply.text: It was actually way easier than you think! Apple already exposes raw access to the camera as an API so it was basically just putting it in a frame and then making sure it was performant. it was actually interesting seeing how much they give you. Now it makes sense how people are making these very robust custom camera apps 👀
